analysis_notes.summary: Dr. Chao evaluates Lamar Jackson's left eversion ankle sprain. Expects him to play but notes his rushing/cutting effectiveness will be noticeably limited.
analysis_notes.speaker: Dr. David Chao
analysis_notes.quote: I think his running ability will be limited in cutting ability.

analysis_notes.summary: Arizona Cardinals suffering severe cluster injuries in the secondary, driving up game totals and defensive vulnerability.
analysis_notes.speaker: Dr. David Chao
analysis_notes.quote: The Arizona Cardinals have been one of the more injured teams... especially at DB.

analysis_notes.summary: Barkley played on a strict snap count (9 plays, 9 touches) due to lingering hamstring and back issues, carrying significant re-injury risk.
analysis_notes.speaker: Dr. David Chao
analysis_notes.quote: Clearly he was on a snap count. Clearly to me he wasn't 100%.

analysis_notes.summary: Panthers OT Taylor Moton suffered a high ankle fracture and ligament tear, ruling him out for the season and leaving Panther OL heavily compromised.
analysis_notes.speaker: Dr. David Chao
analysis_notes.quote: Breaks his ankle, high ankle fracture, ligament tear, done for the season.
